classification.difficultyReason: Identify the appropriate semicircle branch and derive the squared radius from a labelled intercept or a supplied point.

content.prompt: Write down the equation of each semicircle.

spec.description: Upper semicircle with marked horizontal endpoints and three intercept labels; no grid or scale ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: The curve and its supplied intercepts remain visible; its equation is answer-only.

answer.worked:
The radius is $3$, and the curve is above the $x$-axis.
$$\begin{align*}x^2+y^2&=9\\y^2&=9-x^2\\y&=\sqrt{9-x^2}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Left semicircle with three intercept labels and no printed endpoint dots, grid or scale ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied semicircle and intercepts visible; equation withheld.

answer.worked:
The radius is $1$, and the curve is left of the $y$-axis.
$$\begin{align*}x^2+y^2&=1\\x^2&=1-y^2\\x&=-\sqrt{1-y^2}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right semicircle with marked vertical endpoints and three radical intercept labels; no grid or scale ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied semicircle and intercepts visible; equation withheld.

answer.worked:
The radius is $\sqrt3$, so $r^2=3$. The curve is right of the $y$-axis.
$$\begin{align*}x^2+y^2&=3\\x^2&=3-y^2\\x&=\sqrt{3-y^2}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upper semicircle with marked diameter endpoints and marked point (-3,4). Endpoints have no numerical labels; no grid or ticks.
spec.mathematics: Centre (0,0); marked point determines squared radius 25.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original point coordinates are labelled; derived radius and equation are withheld.

spec.description: Lower semicircle with marked horizontal endpoints and marked point (-1,-1). No numerical endpoint labels, grid or ticks.
spec.mathematics: Centre (0,0); marked point determines squared radius 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original point coordinates are labelled; derived radius and equation are withheld.

spec.description: Right semicircle with marked vertical endpoints and marked point (2,-1). No numerical endpoint labels, grid or ticks.
spec.mathematics: Centre (0,0); marked point determines squared radius 5.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original point coordinates are labelled; derived radius and equation are withheld.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}r^2&=2^2+(-1)^2\\r^2&=5.\end{align*}$$
The curve is right of the $y$-axis.
$$\begin{align*}x^2+y^2&=5\\x^2&=5-y^2\\x&=\sqrt{5-y^2}.\end{align*}$$
